raw.title: Security Engineer
raw.description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that builds trust, sparks innovation, and strengthens team culture.

 

About Superhuman

Superhuman is an AI productivity suite that makes AI work for everyone. Over 40 million people rely on it daily to get work done. A recognized leader in productivity tools, Superhuman is the maker of popular products including Docs, Fathom, Go, GPTZero, Grammarly, and Mail. The newest product, Superhuman Go, builds on Grammarly’s ability to deliver help everywhere people work. It lets anyone build proactive agents that act as teammates across more than 1 million apps and websites, without changing how they work. Learn more at superhuman.com.

 

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Security Engineer to join our Detection & Response Team to achieve our ambitious goals. This role will contribute to our D&R team as hands-on practitioner across incident response, detection engineering, threat hunting, and threat intelligence. You'll plan, execute, and debrief complex security operations, leveraging those insights to enhance our threat mitigation capabilities and build robust, automated security tooling across all Superhuman environments.

Additionally, you'll own key workstreams in executing and advancing our security vision, translating strategic objectives into tactical implementations through strong technical execution and innovative solution building, with particular emphasis on automation and AI-powered security solutions. You'll conduct research across security domains and automation technologies, identifying opportunities to enhance our capabilities through cutting-edge approaches and intelligent automation. Finally, you'll bring an attacker mindset into Superhuman’s engineering and security culture, thinking like a threat actor to defend our systems in a way that is grounded in how real attacks happen.

Superhuman's engineers and researchers have the freedom to innovate and uncover breakthroughs—and, in turn, influence our product roadmap. The complexity of our technical challenges is growing rapidly as we scale our interfaces, algorithms, and infrastructure. Curious how we build and operate our AI agents? Check out our engineering blog, and explore our threat-hunting AI here.

As a Security Engineer, you will:

  • Own the IR strategy end-to-end, building, maintaining, and operating the systems and tooling that strengthen our ability to detect, contain, and recover from security incidents at scale

  • Build and maintain automated threat detection systems, AI-driven alert triage solutions, and security intelligence pipelines that scale with business growth

  • Conduct threat hunting and detection engineering, developing detection-as-code, hunting-as-code, and intelligence-as-code capabilities.

  • Research and develop cutting-edge security automation and AI-powered security solutions to deepen and scale our ability to identify threats, including autonomous security agents.

  • Operate without traditional scope limitations, following attacker kill chains to uncover security gaps that scoped teams miss.

  • Lead complex security investigations, including insider threat scenarios and sophisticated attack campaigns.

  • Maintain incident response capabilities and serve as part of the Incident Command on-call schedule.

  • Embed attacker mindset thinking throughout the organization through education and collaboration with engineering teams.

Qualifications

  • Has 3+ years of relevant experience in security engineering, with expertise across multiple disciplines including incident response and detection engineering (threat intelligence, threat hunting experience is nice to have too)

  • Proven incident response leadership and complex security investigation experience.

  • Automation and development skills in Python, Go, or similar languages, with experience building production security tooling.

  • Knowledge of cloud security architecture.

  • Research mindset with an ability to identify novel attack vectors and develop creative, pragmatic solutions.

  • Thrives in ambiguous environments and can deliver meaningful results at a rapid pace while managing multiple competing priorities.

  • Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with CI/CD security integration, identity and access management concepts, and security orchestration.

  • Experience with large-scale Kubernetes clusters.

  • Background in AI/ML applications for security, including experience with or interest in developing autonomous security systems.

 

Compensation and Benefits

  • Professional Growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first, hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture rooted in our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our team member resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

  • Relocation Support: Superhuman provides relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

 

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations—to apply. Superhuman is an equal opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, sexual identity, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, criminal prosecution, judgment in a criminal case, or any other characteristic protected by law.

For more details about the personal data Superhuman collects during the recruitment process, for what purposes, and how you can address your rights, please see the Superhuman Data Privacy Notice for Candidates here.

Compensation: €80K – €150K

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The Role

As a Technical Delivery Manager at Legora, you will play a central role in ensuring customers successfully deploy, integrate, and adopt our AI-native platform. You'll lead end-to-end technical implementations, act as the primary technical point of contact, and shape how seamlessly new customers go live and scale within Legora.

 

What You'll Be Doing

  • Lead integration projects from kickoff through go-live, owning technical documentation, test plans, and rollout execution to ensure on-time, high-quality delivery

  • Serve as the dedicated technical point of contact during implementation and early adoption, including proactive monitoring and regular stakeholder updates through go-live and the post-rollout period

  • Configure and support customer environments including SSO, DMS integrations (iManage, SharePoint, NetDocuments), and API-based connections

  • Provide dedicated post-rollout technical support for enterprise clients, troubleshooting advanced issues and driving high customer satisfaction

  • Coordinate across Sales, Engineering, and Customer Success to align on requirements and ensure a smooth rollout experience

  • Deliver technical training and guidance to customer teams on configuration, workflows, and best practices

  • Feed insights from delivery projects back to product and engineering to improve future implementations

Who You Are

  • Proven experience in technical delivery, implementation, or a similar customer-facing technical role

  • Strong hands-on experience with SSO, authentication protocols, and enterprise integrations (DMS platforms, APIs)

  • Excellent project management skills with a structured, proactive approach to managing multiple parallel projects

  • Able to translate technical concepts clearly for non-technical audiences

  • Strong communicator who builds trusted relationships across customer and internal teams

  • Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

  • Professional proficiency in French or German

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Compensation: €90K – €105K

Du übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung in der operativen Buchhaltung und bringst Dein Know-how in die Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Abläufen ein. title: Projektmanager Instandhaltung und Sanierung (m/w/d)
description: Sie kommen vom Bau oder aus dem Handwerk, erkennen auf den ersten Blick, ob eine Arbeit sauber ausgeführt ist, und wollen Maßnahmen nicht mehr selbst ausführen, sondern voranbringen? Dann sind Sie bei uns richtig. Die Immobetriebe Hausverwaltung GmbH ist ein inhabergeführtes Unternehmen in Konstanz. Wir verwalten Wohnungseigentümergemeinschaften, Mietshäuser und größere Gewerbeobjekte im Raum Konstanz, Radolfzell und Singen. Wir arbeiten weitgehend digital: ein Vorgangssystem für alle Fälle, KI-Assistenz bei Routinen und Abläufe, die wir aufschreiben und gemeinsam verbessern. Bisher haben unsere Verwalter die Umsetzung von Instandhaltung und Sanierung neben ihren rechtlichen Aufgaben mitgetragen. Diese Aufgabe lösen wir jetzt heraus und machen sie zu einer eigenen Stelle, die eng mit den Verwaltern zusammenarbeitet: Die Verwaltung führt Versammlung und Beschluss, Sie bringen die beschlossenen Maßnahmen auf die Baustelle und zum Abschluss. About the role 

 

At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, and the first AI agent marketplace for hospitality in our Agent Hub, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers. 

We're looking for a senior Product Manager to ownin our AI product domain. You'll turn our AI capabilities into coherent, commercially viable products that solve real operational problems for hoteliers. Your goal is to help hotels move towards genuinely autonomous operations, not to ship isolated automations or AI assistants. 

This is not a backlog role. You'll take an ambiguous opportunity, find the right customer problems, define the proposition, build it with Engineering, bring it to market and drive adoption. You'll also play a central role in turning our AI capabilities into a meaningful and growing source of revenue. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with real autonomy. You won't receive a roadmap and execute it. You'll shape it along our vision, using customer insight, data and sound reasoning. You'll work closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, and in close collaboration with our other value stream teams.  

 

What you'll be up to 

  • Productising and commercialising our AI capabilities. Define the proposition, target customers and use cases, and shape packaging and launch with commercial teams. 
  • Building the foundations for AI across our ecosystem. Shape how our AI capabilities understand each hotel's context and work reliably with Apaleo and connected systems across operational areas. 
  • Productising hospitality knowledge. Turn hospitality expertise and operational processes into scalable product experiences, with appropriate human oversight. 
  • Driving autonomy and measurable value. Think in complete outcomes, such as staff hours saved and manual work removed. Show hoteliers tangible ROI. 
  • Driving adoption. Run discovery, shape onboarding and usability, measure adoption and improve from real-world feedback. 
  • Keeping AI products reliable and viable. Define good agent performance, understand cost and latency, set up evaluation and monitoring with Engineering, and trade off autonomy, reliability, human intervention and cost. 
  • Owning strategy, roadmap and delivery in your scope, with clear specs, a definition of done and impact analysis. 
  • Working with Engineering on trade-offs, dependencies, quality and our API-first AI-first architecture. 
  • Balancing ambition with reality. Weigh the roadmap against operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and say no to good ideas that aren't great ones. 
  • Spotting dependencies early with Hotel Operations and other engineering teams, since our AI capabilities build on the core platform. 
  • Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering.  

 

What you'll bring 

  • 6+ years as a Product Manager, owning products from discovery through launch and adoption with limited day-to-day direction. 
  • Proven zero-to-one experience. You've taken a new B2B product, not a feature, from an ambiguous problem to paying customers, driving discovery, validation, definition, prioritisation and launch. 
  • Ownership after launch. You've owned a revenue, adoption or retention number and can tell us what moved and what you killed, pivoted or repriced. 
  • Commercial thinking. You've defined propositions, packaging and pricing, validated willingness to pay and worked with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success on go-to-market. 
  • Systems and process thinking. You break processes into steps, decisions and handoffs, and understand how systems with different data models and sources of truth affect the reliability of agents. 
  • Meaningful AI product experience. You've built and launched AI-powered products or capabilities used by real customers, understand what makes a product agentic, and can discuss context, tools, latency, cost and evaluation, with a view on human-in-the-loop design. 
  • Customer centricity and product judgement. You turn interview patterns into opportunities, make tough trade-offs and prioritise ruthlessly. 
  • Platform thinking. You weigh customer needs against reusable capabilities, API consistency and long-term platform evolution. 
  • Stakeholder alignment. You align Engineering, commercial teams and peers, manage cross-team dependencies and communicate trade-offs with confidence. 
  • Autonomy and adaptability. You take ownership, raise risks early and make progress through ambiguity. 

 

Strongly preferred 

  • Agentic AI products in production. You've taken an agentic AI product beyond prototype to paying customers, and dealt with reliability, permissions, exceptions, human intervention and evaluation. This is different from AI-powered features such as chatbots, summarisation or copilots. 

 

Nice to have 

  • Hospitality technology or hotel operations experience. 
  • Experience with PMS, RMS, CRS, channel managers, OTAs or hospitality distribution. 
  • Experience in B2B SaaS platforms, ecosystems or integration-heavy products. 
  • Experience with AI governance, permissions, identity, orchestration or enterprise AI adoption. 
  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up. 
  • Comfort with AI-assisted engineering processes. 

 

Don't tick every box? Hospitality experience is an advantage, not a prerequisite. A strong zero-to-one B2B product builder from another domain, with real AI product experience and a commercial mindset, can be a better fit than a hospitality specialist without them. We'd still love to hear from you. 

 

Who you are 

  • You take high ownership. You answer for product outcomes, not just delivery commitments. 
  • You're strategic and hands-on. You can set a product vision and still get into customer discovery, operational processes and detailed product decisions. 
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. You make progress when the problem or the solution isn't fully defined. 
  • You think commercially. You ask what customers will buy and why, not just what Engineering can build. 
  • You're customer obsessed. You understand real operational pain and test your assumptions with customers. 
  • You're technically curious. You know enough about AI and agentic systems to hold meaningful discussions with engineers and make informed product decisions. 
  • You measure what matters. You judge success by customer outcomes, adoption and commercial impact, not features shipped. 

 

What we offer 

Culture and growth 

  • A diverse and international team. Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique perspectives and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech. 
  • Growth and development. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. 
  • Autonomy and ownership. Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly, in an environment built on trust and transparency. 
  • Competitive and fair compensation. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. 

 

Perks and lifestyle 

  • Flexible and remote work options. We focus on results, not clocking hours. Work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup. 
  • Free public transport. Travel across Germany with a fully covered Deutschland Ticket. 
  • Paid time off. 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired. 
  • Health and wellbeing. Access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership. 

 

Joining Apaleo 

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo is more than taking on a role. It's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions and help redefine the future of hospitality tech.

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Site Reliability Engineers who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will need to reside in Germany with legal working permits or residence permits.  

 

The role:  

 

  • Infrastructure Management: Maintain and manage new and existing infrastructure, balancing both proactive and reactive maintenance. 

  • Technical Problem Identification and Resolution: Identify technical problems and bottlenecks. Collaborate with the engineering team to resolve these issues efficiently. 

  • ISO Compliance: Ensure all infrastructure and processes are in compliance with ISO standards, and assist in maintaining those certifications. 

  • Production Support: Work closely with engineering teams to ensure our developed tools and applications run smoothly in a production environment. 

  • Backup Management: Oversee and manage all system backups, ensuring Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) are met. 

  • Release Management Support: Assist in managing software releases to minimize disruption and maximize uptime. 

  • Off-Duty Support: Participate in an off-duty or pager duty rotation to provide round-the-clock system reliability and support. 

  • Incident Review and Analysis: Lead postmortems following any system disruptions, and help identify ways to prevent future incidents. 

  • Infrastructure Monitoring: Monitor system alerts and respond quickly to maintain system health and maximize uptime. 

  • Capacity Planning: Participate in planning server capacity, ensuring we can meet current and future demands 


  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or a related field. 

  • 7+ years of experience in site reliability engineering or a similar role.

  • 3+ years in SRE, DevOps, or related infrastructure roles  

  • Experience supporting/coaching less experienced team members. 

  • Ability in building alerting and observability into all production systems (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch etc.)

  • Proven experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS (ECS, EC2, etc) or Azure. 

  • Extensive experience using Terraform and Ansible. 

  • Incident management, postmortems, and on-call quality of life experience

  • Familiarity with disaster recovery planning and testing. 

  • Strong knowledge of system monitoring tools. 

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex issues. 

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills. 

  • Proven experience managing system backups and understanding of RTO and RPO. 

  • Familiarity with release management processes. 

  • Ability to work in an on-call capacity. 

  • Define the Site Reliability Strategy and Execute on it 

  • Experience in managing Stakeholders and expectations from Stakeholders 

  • Experience in dealing with concurring priorities / context switching 

  • Proficiency in Python.

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in Germany, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect.

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact.

description: Operations & Strategy Manager Permanent employee · Full-time · Berlin (HQ) Our mission for you European energy costs are twice as high as in the US and China, and electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. This puts European industry under massive cost pressure – and companies need to act now. trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that brings together energy procurement, energy management and the marketing of flexible assets in one product. This helps companies save up to 30% on their recurring electricity costs while switching to renewable energy. We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast – the market window is open and we intend to own it. Now we are looking for an Operations & Strategy Manager to own a business-critical part of our energy value chain: the processes behind how we configure, price and quote long-term energy products for our customers. About trawa trawa is a tech-driven scale-up based in Berlin with around 100 employees, combining deep energy market expertise with in-house software development. We've raised over €35M to date, most recently a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic and Tiny VC. This role is based in our Berlin office, where we work together in person most of the week. We offer flexible working hours, so you can shape your day in a way that works for you. The Team You'll join our Energy & Trading team, which owns the energy side of our business – from sourcing and portfolio management to making sure our customers' energy products work in practice. You'll report directly to our Energy & Trading Manager and work closely with the COO, our Trading Team, Sales, Pricing, Product and Tech. You start without direct reports, but with a clear mandate: own our CPQ process end-to-end and grow the margin it generates. Who we are looking for Strong quantitative skills: You think analytically, feel at home with numbers and data and can confidently challenge quantitative results – without having to be a quant or developer yourself. Ideally, you have a degree in a quantitative or business field (e.g. economics, engineering, industrial engineering, business administration). Business acumen & process mindset: You think commercially, care about margins and unit economics, enjoy turning messy processes into robust, scalable ones and prioritise by impact. Experience with commercial processes such as pricing or deal desks, in energy, financial services or any other industry, is a plus. Interest in energy markets: You are fascinated by how energy markets work – from wholesale and forward markets to PPAs, hedging and pricing – and want to dive deep into them. Knowledge of the German energy market is a plus; experience in (energy) trading is explicitly not required – what matters is your drive to understand the mechanics and make the processes behind them work. Hungry & ambitious: You want to grow fast, take on responsibility early and set high standards for yourself. You don't wait for instructions and enjoy a steep learning curve, and work experience in a high-paced environment, e.g. a start-up, scale-up or consulting, is a plus. High ownership & structured execution: You drive topics end-to-end, align stakeholders across departments and turn ideas into scalable processes with tangible business impact. An affinity for AI-powered tools and automation to make processes faster and smarter is a plus. Strong communication: You speak German at native level and very good English, and you translate confidently between commercial, quantitative and operational perspectives. What you'll do As Operations & Strategy Manager, you combine a strong analytical mind with process excellence and commercial drive: Own our CPQ process: You take end-to-end ownership of our CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) processes for long-term energy products – from the customer request through pricing and offer creation to trade execution, across Sales, Pricing, Trading and Operations and for all our customer segments. You make this process faster, more robust and scalable. Stabilise and grow our margins: Our customers hedge their energy costs with long-term products from us, such as PPAs and Futures/Forwards. You are responsible for stabilising our margins on these hedges and increasing them in the medium term – covering a multi-million euro gross margin. Pave the way to more complex products: Over the past three years, we have shown that we can profitably price, buy and sell energy. You build on that foundation and develop our long-term offering towards more complex, higher-margin products that fit our customers' needs even better. Bridge between trading and business: You work closely with our quant trading and data science team and turn their models and insights into processes and systems that work across teams and markets – so that pricing, risk and market insights reliably translate into better decisions and products for our customers. 90 Day Goals After 6 Weeks (Onboarding): Business understanding: You have understood trawa's business, product and energy value chain in detail and got to know all relevant internal and external stakeholders. Portfolio knowledge: You understand our long-term product portfolio (PPAs, Futures/Forwards), our customers' hedging needs and how pricing, margins and risk come together in our offers. CPQ mapping: You have mapped our current CPQ process – from customer request and pricing to offer creation and trade execution – and identified the key pain points and margin levers. Month 3 (Ramp-Up): Go-to CPQ owner: You are the go-to person for our CPQ process and have implemented first improvements that make it faster and more robust. Margin transparency: You have created transparency on our margins across long-term hedges and derived first measures to stabilise them. Target process: You have designed a target CPQ process, started its implementation and proposed first, more complex products for our long-term offering. Why us? Impact: European SMEs spend between €150k and €10M per year on electricity – most are overpaying and locked into outdated procurement. Your work will directly change how thousands of companies buy, manage and use energy. The impact is measurable, the market is massive, and the timing is now. Ownership: We empower our team members to take ownership of their work and drive results, regardless of background or experience level. Learning & Growth: We provide an annual budget and dedicated time for professional development. You'll have opportunities for mentorship, learning and career progression. Diversity and Inclusion: We're an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects that. Our organisation brings together over 15 nationalities, contributing a variety of languages, experiences and perspectives. At trawa, we're family-friendly with parents across all levels, and our diversity is represented throughout the company, including leadership. We're committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. Package & Benefits: We offer a competitive compensation package including salary and stock options, 30 days of vacation, and a range of benefits including subsidies for home internet and lunches, a Sports Club membership, dedicated learning days with an annual learning budget, plus a weekly team lunch and regular team events. At trawa, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly, we encourage you to apply – you may be the right fit for this or another opportunity. As Facility Development Lead, you’ll own the integrated development plan for Focused Energy’s Biblis facility. You’ll translate technical requirements into coordinated facility, utility, planning, and permitting workstreams, aligning engineering teams with RWE/Biblis stakeholders and external design partners. You’ll drive priorities, dependencies, and decisions so the site can progress through development with a clear, realistic plan.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with energy, nuclear-adjacent, research, cleanroom, laser, laboratory, or high-tech industrial facilities.

What We Offer

description: Company Overview Mindpeak is a Hamburg-based AI company on a mission to make cancer diagnosis more accurate, efficient and personalized. We build deep-learning solutions for computational pathology that bring AI directly into clinical practice. About Jimdo

We exist to unleash the power of the self-employed - helping solopreneurs and micro-businesses thrive by doing what they're passionate about and removing the complexity of building lasting, successful businesses.

Jimdo started in 2007 when three school friends built a website builder in a Northern German farmhouse to help everyone build a presence online. Today, we're a profitable, remote-first company with 220+ people from 50+ nationalities working across 15+ countries. We've helped build over 36 million websites to get online across the world.

We're more than just a website builder. We're an AI-powered platform that helps self-employed people actually run and build successful businesses — from getting found online, winning customers and running their business with a peace of mind by knowing exactly what to do next to move forward.

At the heart of Jimdo is a strong belief in personalized, data-driven guidance. Our platform combines design, business tools, and an AI-powered core that turns real customer data into clear insights and next steps helping our customers focus on what moves their business forward.

Role Overview

At Jimdo, we think the best support is the one a customer never needs. When our customers, self-employed people and small business owners, do need help, it should come fast: from self-service and AI first, and from a person when that's what the case needs.

We're bringing our support tooling, Zendesk, chatbots and AI work together into one team with one backlog and one roadmap. As Senior Product Owner, you'll lead that team and own the outcome: more questions answered by AI, faster help, lower cost to serve, and customers who still trust us.

You'll also shape where this goes next. Over the next couple of years AI will handle more and more first-line support, and you'll decide how the work is split between AI and people, and build the platform around it.

 

The team and who you'll work with

You'll report to the Head of Customer Support Services and join CSS, our support organisation.

You'll lead a small team of Zendesk and AI specialists and work day to day with the engineers who build our support tools.

You'll work closely with our knowledge and readiness team, support agents and team leads, product teams, our Company AI team, Data & Analytics, and our support and AI vendors.

 

What you'll be doing:

  • Set the vision for our support platform and AI with the Head of CSS, and turn it into a roadmap, a business case and results.

  • Lead, coach and grow your team, and bring specialists and engineers together around one backlog and clear quarterly outcomes.

  • Own how well our chatbot, Zendesk AI agents and Copilot perform: define what a good AI answer is, measure it, and switch off what doesn't help customers.

  • Improve routing, user identification and self-service entry points so customers get to the right answer faster.

  • Spend real time with customers and support agents: read tickets, listen to chats, see where people get stuck.

  • Build a written case for every bigger piece of work, own the cost to serve, and check results against your forecast.

  • Turn what you learn in support into evidence that helps product teams fix problems at the source.

Your first months

  • After 3 months: your team works from one backlog and one outcome roadmap, and the quality bar for AI answers is agreed.

  • After 6 months: you've delivered and reported your first quarterly outcome, including how AI resolution compares with your forecast.

What you bring to the table

  • 5+ years as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally including support, CX, service or internal platform products.

  • You've shipped AI or chatbot features in production and can name the metric you moved, the baseline and the result.

  • You explain product decisions in commercial terms: cost, savings, effect, and what you learned when a forecast was wrong.

  • You've managed people and led people who didn't report to you, ideally across departments.

  • You do your own analysis with SQL or BI tools, and design and read experiments without waiting for an analyst.

  • A clear point of view on what a good support experience is, and fluent English for everyday work.

  • Hands-on experience with Zendesk (or a similar tool such as Intercom or Salesforce Service Cloud), including AI agents, routing and automations.

Flexibility and Trust: Our work environment thrives on flexibility and trust. We offer fully remote work set-up  with opportunities for in-person collaboration. You can manage your working hours flexibly because we prioritize the results you deliver over the number of hours you put in. 

An International Diverse Team: Our team is a mosaic of over 248 individuals hailing from 50+ different countries and working across 15+ diverse locations. We take pride in our openness and inclusivity.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product. Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy. YOUR IMPACT As a Mechanical Design Engineer, you will significantly contribute to the design, analysis, validation and realisation of Proxima’s Alpha stellarator fusion machine. Your innovative and detailed engineering work will deliver robust mechanical, structural, and thermal performance of critical systems, tooling and manufacturing processes. You will also work with external collaborators and suppliers to develop the designs, equipment, systems and materials that will enable Proxima’s mission to deliver clean, sustainable fusion energy. WHAT YOU WILL DO Develop innovative solutions and detailed mechanical designs for significant systems within the Alpha stellarator, ensuring integration with the broader physics, mechanical and structural systems. Carry out thermal and structural analysis and assessment of mechanical designs, providing design input and implementing recommended design improvements. Conduct technology trade-offs, materials selections and feasibility studies to facilitate the successful identification of the Alpha net energy stellarator. Design, deliver, and support the prototyping and verification of the components, materials, assemblies and manufacturing processes selected for Alpha. Work with external suppliers and collaborators to assist and guide the development and manufacture of the components and systems that will come together to demonstrate the net energy Alpha stellarator. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR High performers with excellent communication and problem-solving skills who love challenges and are not afraid to experiment, take risks, and learn from mistakes. Experience in designing and analysing mechanical components and assemblies, with proficiency in CAD (experience with 3DExperience/CATIA v6 and ANSYS is highly beneficial, but not essential). Experience in designing and delivering the conceptual and detailed design of mechanical, structural, thermal or electro-mechanical equipment, particularly for use in research, development, prototyping and manufacturing. Knowledge and experience of designing and selecting materials for some or all of the following engineering applications: high temperature, cryogenic, electromagnetic, vacuum. Demonstrated ability to work with and manage external suppliers, with multidisciplinary technical teams in fast-paced, dynamic settings. Proficiency with programming languages used in science and engineering (particularly Python) is highly beneficial but not essential. INTERVIEW PROCESS Recruiter Interview (30-45 min) Portfolio Presentation & Review (45-60 min) Technical Panel Interviews (2x60 min) CEO call (30 min) Successful applicants will be assigned to one of the Engineering teams within Proxima, depending on their specific skills, location, and the needs of the organisation. This role sits at L2/L3/L4 of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table. description: <h2><strong>About the role: What's in the Box</strong></h2> <p>In this role you will be part of the Global Price &amp; Discount Strategy Team, shaping pricing and discount strategy across our full global portfolio which includes our core brand, HelloFresh, as well as: Factor, GreenChef, EveryPlate, Chef's Plate, and Youfoodz. You will own the strategy and execution of our global roadmap for active customer &amp; referral incentives, partnering closely with local market leadership, tech, marketing, and more which makes this a unique opportunity to combine analytical depth, strategic thinking, and cross-functional execution.</p> <p>Please note that this position is a 24-month fixed-term contract (with the aim of converting it to a permanent position afterwards).</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do: The Recipe</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Global Referral Strategy: </strong>Own the conceptualization, execution, and optimization of our global referral incentive strategy, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and market conditions and translating strategy into tangible action.</li> <li><strong style="text-align: justify;">Loyalty Program &amp; Retention Economics: </strong><span style="text-align: justify;">Lead incentive strategy and impact modeling to drive performance of our emerging loyalty program and churn prevention initiatives.</span></li> <li><strong>Advanced Testing &amp; Analysis:</strong> Own the full AB testing lifecycle from hypothesis generation and test setup to execution and post-test analysis to constantly refine our incentive models.</li> <li><strong>Data-Driven Optimization:</strong> Identify opportunities to improve current global strategies through deep-dive analysis, increasing customer lifetime value while balancing top and bottom-line growth.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Engagement:</strong> Partner with and influence senior leadership and global teams (e.g., Lifecycle Marketing, Product, Analytics) in setting strategy roadmaps and sharing recommendations that drive impactful decision-making.</li> <li><strong>Playbook Development:</strong> Establish and refine best practices and playbooks to ensure a consistent, scalable approach to pricing and discount initiatives across all markets.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring: The Ingredients&nbsp;</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Master’s degree in Business/Management, Business Analytics, Economics or any related field.</li> <li>4-6 years of professional experience in pricing strategy, consulting, analytics, or a subscription-based business model.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills and advanced command of Excel with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights, additional SQL-knowledge is a plus.</li> <li>Extensive experience devising and measuring the effectiveness of discount strategies (including AB testing), with a proven track record from other data-rich business environments.</li> <li>Outstanding written and verbal communication skills including the ability to lead effective meetings and presentations with senior management.</li> <li>Track record of end-to-end project ownership in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Outstanding attention to detail to ensure analysis accuracy.</li> </ul> <p class="p1">Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. title: Senior Group Marketing Controller (All Genders)
description: <h1><strong>The role</strong></h1> <p style="text-align: justify;">The Group Marketing Controller is the primary finance interface for HelloFresh's global marketing function. The role exists to ensure marketing spend is planned accurately, closed correctly, and reported transparently — bridging the gap between marketing execution and the Group P&amp;L.</p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Above all, we are looking for people who will <strong>make HelloFresh</strong> <strong>better.</strong> We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! Close &amp; Accruals</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the month-end close process for marketing cost lines across all markets</li> <li>Review and validate marketing accruals submitted by local finance teams</li> <li>Identify and resolve booking errors, misclassifications, or missing accruals</li> <li>Maintain clean actuals in the income statement for all marketing line items</li> <li>Work with SE Finance Controlling to improve and create transparency to the markets on marketing IC charges</li> </ul> <h3><strong>2. Budget &amp; Forecast Management</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Consolidate and challenge market-level marketing budgets during planning cycles</li> <li>Lead marketing Guidance creation for Business Plan cycles</li> <li>Maintain the Group marketing budget with actuals vs. budget vs. forecast</li> <li>Flag material variances early and escalate to marketing stakeholders</li> </ul> <h3><strong>3. Reporting &amp; Analysis</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Work with Tech and local markets to improve and automate input quality of weekly reporting</li> <li>Produce monthly marketing performance reports covering spend vs. budget, phasing, and key variance drivers (Leverage A.I. and Databricks Dashboards)</li> <li>Support the CFO/board reporting pack with accurate marketing cost commentary</li> <li>Build and maintain performance reports for Global Marketing teams</li> </ul> <h3><strong>4. Business Partnering</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Act as the day-to-day finance contact for the Global Marketing teams</li> <li>Manage Direct and Indirect spend for the Marketing team</li> </ul> <h3><strong>5. Process &amp; Controls</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Document and improve the end-to-end marketing close process</li> <li>Ensure consistent cost treatment across markets (e.g. working vs. non-working spend, agency fees, media)</li> <li>Identify gaps in how marketing costs are captured and propose fixes</li> </ul> <h4><strong>WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Clean marketing close every month — no material restatements or late accruals</li> <li>Stakeholders can trust the marketing numbers without re-checking them</li> <li>Variances are explained proactively, not reactively</li> <li>Marketing controller processes are standardised across markets</li> </ul> <h4><strong>WHAT THE FUTURE LOOKS LIKE</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Manage marketing spend between markets by reviewing ROI, AOR and agreed upon KPI performance</li> <li>Centralised and automated marketing controlling at month-end</li> </ul> <h4><strong>WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Not a marketing strategist — not expected to have opinions on campaign effectiveness or brand direction</li> <li>Not a data analyst — analytical support comes from the Finance Systems team; this role translates outputs into financial conclusions</li> <li>Not a local market controller — this role holds the Group view; local controllers own their market execution</li> </ul> <h1><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h1> <ul> <li>Several years of experience in financial controlling, FP&amp;A, or a similar finance business-partnering role, ideally with exposure to marketing or performance-marketing cost structures</li> <li>Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills; comfort working with large datasets and BI/reporting tools</li> <li>Ability to explain financial variances clearly to non-finance stakeholders</li> <li>Experience running or supporting a month-end close process</li> <li>Comfort operating across multiple markets and currencies in a fast-paced, matrixed organisation</li> <li>Curiosity about how AI and automation can modernise financial reporting</li> </ul> <h1><strong>What we offer</strong></h1> <p>Elevate your lifestyle! From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Are you up for the challenge?</strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please submit your complete application below including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.</span></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within 5 business days.&nbsp;</span></p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Constructor Student Labs
description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <h4>Student Labs: Constructor Fabric Research Edition</h4> <p><strong>Curious how AI is changing the way software is built? Want to explore it hands-on, guided by the researchers who work on it every day?</strong></p> <p>Constructor Tech and Constructor Labs, together with Constructor University, invite you to <strong>Student Labs</strong>: a 2-month educational research program for BSc and MSc students.</p> <p>This edition is dedicated to <strong>Constructor Fabric</strong>, a shared AI and software platform. Fabric brings together reusable building blocks, common infrastructure and AI agents that help design, build and test software.</p> <h5>🚀 Why Constructor Fabric?</h5> <p>AI-native software platforms are one of the <strong>fastest-growing fields in tech</strong>, and few students get to study one from the inside. Student Labs gives you that chance. You explore open research questions on a platform in active development, learn current research methods, and build skills that are in high demand in industry and academia.</p> <h5>🔬 What you can research</h5> <h5>&nbsp;</h5> <p><strong>AI that builds software</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Domain-specific languages (DSL):</strong> how a formal language can describe software components so that AI can generate and regenerate them from specifications</li> <li><strong>Neurosymbolic models:</strong> combining neural networks with logic and rules, so that AI-generated code can be checked, not just produced</li> <li><strong>Rule extraction and fine-tuning:</strong> how to extract rules and knowledge from existing code and use them to adapt language models</li> <li><strong>World models:</strong> how AI systems build an internal model of their environment to understand, plan and predict</li> <li><strong>Formal verification:</strong> mathematical methods that prove software behaves as specified</li> <li><strong>Geometric models:</strong> using geometry to represent data and help AI models learn from it</li> <li><strong>Benchmarking:</strong> how to measure fairly whether one AI model or method is really better than another</li> </ul> <p><strong>Next-generation language models</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Diffusion models for text:</strong> today’s LLMs write one token at a time, which makes them slow and prone to hallucinations. Diffusion models generate whole passages at once. Explore how to make them match and beat today’s models.</li> <li><strong>LLM security:</strong> how to host large language models securely when many users and organisations share the same system</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h5>💡 What you’ll experience</h5> <ul> <li>Explore an open research question that matches your level: beginner, intermediate or advanced</li> <li>Learn from weekly mentoring sessions with Constructor researchers and engineers</li> <li>Exchange ideas with other students, and study solo or in a pair</li> <li>Present your results as a research report, prototype or research concept</li> </ul> <h5>🎓 Who can apply?</h5> <ul> <li>BSc and MSc students of Constructor University and our partner universities</li> <li>Students with a strong interest in AI, LLMs, software engineering or research. Beginners are welcome!</li> </ul> <h5>👉 How it works</h5> <ol> <li><strong>Choose a topic</strong> from a curated list proposed by our researchers.</li> <li><strong>Find your level.</strong> Topics are offered for beginner, intermediate and advanced students, so everyone can find one that fits.</li> <li><strong>Study solo or in a pair</strong>, depending on the topic.</li> <li><strong>Lead your own research</strong> and set your own schedule, with weekly guidance from your mentor.</li> <li><strong>Present your results</strong> and receive feedback and a certificate of completion.</li> </ol> <h5>⭐ Why join?</h5> <ul> <li><strong>Study a fast-growing field</strong> from inside a real AI platform</li> <li><strong>Learn from experts:</strong> weekly mentorship from researchers and engineers</li> <li><strong>Earn academic credit:</strong> depending on your university’s rules, the Labs can count towards your mandatory internship, earn you project credits, or become part of your thesis</li> <li><strong>Publish:</strong> strong results can be published, with you as an author</li> <li><strong>Build your research portfolio</strong> and receive a certificate</li> <li><strong>Next steps:</strong> thesis co-supervision, and you can apply for paid internships in the Constructor ecosystem (separate application)</li> </ul> <p>📅 <strong>Duration:</strong> 2 months<br>📍 <strong>Format:</strong> remote, or hybrid in Bremen (DE), Sofia (BG) or Belgrade (RS)<br>🗓 <strong>Mentoring:</strong> weekly sessions with your mentor. About 10–15 hours a week; you set your own schedule.</p> <p><em>Student Labs is an educational research program, not a job or an internship. Participation is unpaid and voluntary.</em></p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. What you’ll be doing As a Customer Support Senior Associate you will: Spend your time interacting directly with our customers over chat, email and phone, providing them with an effective, easy and enjoyable Pleo experience. Troubleshoot and resolve customers issues related to the Pleo product, and escalate to the appropriate internal team where needed. Provide feedback and support cross-functional teams on product development based on customer insights. Share learnings and contribute to our knowledge base to ensure growth and knowledge sharing across the team, and beyond. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you: Love providing fantastic, high-touch customer support on live chat, email and phone. Have a persistent and analytical approach to problem-solving. Are able to explain complicated problems in the simplest terms. Have a genuine desire to work in a fast-paced, fast-changing and collaborative environment. Are tech-savvy, resilient and curious. Have experience with Support tools such as FreshWorks, Intercom or Zendesk. Have experience with accounting, bookkeeping, financial technology or other relevant product within SaaS. Fluency - Both written and spoken in Danish and English. Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to our Customer Support Lead and work closely with teams across all departments in Pleo. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to giving our customers the best experience possible. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across other departments such as Customer Success & Product to ensure success. How you’ll develop in this role In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll: Learn and understand the Pleo product deeply. Help 500+ users with their Pleo experience. Act as the voice of the customer internally. Take on new product challenges as the company continues to scale and evolve. We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on more advanced support tasks, stepping into leadership, or becoming a subject matter expert within a certain product area. Show me the benefits! Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!). Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office. Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis. We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays. For our Team, we offer hybrid working options. Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice. We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far. Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work. About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us. Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you. Your data is safe. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Karbon</strong></p> <p style="text-align: left;">Karbon is the global leader in AI-powered practice management software for accounting firms. We provide an award-winning cloud platform that helps tens of thousands of accounting professionals work more efficiently and collaboratively every day. With customers in 40 countries, we have grown into a globally distributed team across the US, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the Philippines. We are well-funded, ranked #1 on G2, growing rapidly, and have a people-first culture that is recognized with Great Place To Work® certification and on Fortune magazine's Best Small Workplaces™ List.</p></div><p><strong>Are you a sales professional looking for an opportunity to make an impact in a rapidly growing, award winning and well-funded SaaS business that is disrupting a multibillion-dollar industry?&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We are always looking to connect with top-performing, self-starter sales executives who have the experience and drive to manage all aspects of the sales cycle — from prospecting and lead qualification to demand creation and closing new business.</p> <p><em><strong>While we may not have an active opening at this moment, we’re continuously building our pipeline of exceptional talent and would love to hear from you. When the right opportunity opens up, we move quickly — and we want to already know who you are.</strong></em></p> <p>Our sales team is based throughout the United Kingdom with the flexibility to work remotely. When positions do become available, they represent a tremendous career opportunity with strong professional and financial upside.</p> <p>If this sounds like the kind of team you want to be part of, we’d encourage you to apply and introduce yourself.</p> <h4><strong>About the Role</strong></h4> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">As a Sales Account Executive, you will be responsible for identifying and managing leads and opportunities, demonstrating Karbon’s value, communicating the compelling reason to change, and leading technical demonstrations of our platform while providing a first-class experience and ultimately optimizing how prospects run their firms.&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Respond to prospective customers promptly, book discovery calls with inbound leads, uncover their pain points, and tailor presentations to demonstrate how Karbon will help them modernize their firm, accelerate their growth and retain top talent</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Drive and expand your portfolio of prospects through outbound engagement and call activity (~40% of appointments are generated by the rep)</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Create Outreach sequences leveraging marketing rich content and/or custom campaigns that include phone, email, e-gifting, and LI to secure meetings with decision makers in ICP accounts</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Build and maintain a strong pipeline of opportunities with a minimum of 3 times quota securing next step meetings throughout the process</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Ensure accurate and timely updates of information and forecasts (call/meeting notes, supporting documentation, next steps etc.) in Salesforce/Gong</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Demonstrate how Karbon's value proposition aligns with clients' requirements</span></li> </ul> <h4><strong>About You!</strong></h4> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are looking for someone who thrives working independently in a high growth, fast-paced environment. The ability to multitask, leverage lots of modern software to automate tasks, set and adjust priorities, and be a team-player is critical. If you are hungry to learn and enjoy being a part of a high-performance team where authenticity and passion for action are valued, Karbon is your future home.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Candidates with the following qualifications and experience are encouraged to apply:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">3+ years of experience selling SaaS to mid-market businesses with a track record of being top performing and consistently exceeding quota</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Experience with outbound sales; description: About Lendable Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start: One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK Profitable since 2017 Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot ) So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance . We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days. We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes. Join us if you want to Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1 Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions Build the best technology in-house : we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting About the Role Lendable is a high-growth FinTech building its security operations capability deliberately. As a Senior Security Operations Analyst, you will triage and respond to security alerts, help improve the quality of the detections behind them, and lead the response when a security event becomes an incident. You will investigate alerts and escalations from our MSSP, tune our monitoring so that it finds more of what matters and less of what doesn’t, and act as a trusted Incident Commander for security incidents, from declaration through to post-incident review. You will work with Engineering, IT, Legal, Risk and senior stakeholders, and you will be credible with all of them. AI is used widely across the business, in how we build software, run operations and serve customers, and that changes both what security incidents look like and how quickly we can respond to them. You will use AI and automation as a normal part of your work, and you will be able to investigate and respond to incidents where AI tooling is the cause, the target or the route in. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone with hands-on SOC experience and a track record of commanding incidents. What You’ll Be Doing 1. Alert Triage & Monitoring Triage and investigate alerts across our SIEM, EDR, identity and cloud tooling, taking escalations from our MSSP’s first-line team. Reduce false positives and alert fatigue by tuning detection rules, thresholds and suppressions. Utilise AI and automation to speed up triage, enrichment and response, and to remove repetitive manual work from the analyst workflow. 2. Incident Command & Response Command security incidents, coordinating technical response, decision-making and communications across Engineering, IT, Legal, Risk and senior stakeholders. Give clear, timely updates to executives during live incidents. Lead or support technical investigation and containment across endpoint, identity and cloud (AWS/GCP) environments, including incidents involving AI use, such as prompt injection, or credentials exposed through AI-generated code. Run blameless post-incident reviews, track actions to closure, and feed lessons back into detection, playbooks and controls. Take part in the out-of-hours on-call rota. 3. Operational Reporting & Assurance Track and report SecOps metrics that reflect reality, such as alert quality, time to triage, time to contain, incident volumes and root causes. Maintain accurate incident records and evidence in our incident management platform to support audit and assurance activity. Build working relationships with Engineering, Platform and IT Systems so that incident response is practised before it is needed. What We’re Looking For Proven incident command: Demonstrable experience leading significant security incidents as Incident Commander or lead responder, from declaration to resolution and review. You can describe incidents you have run, the decisions you made and what you changed afterwards. Technical investigation skills: Solid hands-on SOC/DFIR experience, including log analysis, endpoint and identity investigation, and cloud incident response in AWS or GCP. Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the Role

Lendable is a high-growth FinTech building its security operations capability deliberately. As a Senior Security Operations Analyst, you will triage and respond to security alerts, help improve the quality of the detections behind them, and lead the response when a security event becomes an incident.

You will investigate alerts and escalations from our MSSP, tune our monitoring so that it finds more of what matters and less of what doesn’t, and act as a trusted Incident Commander for security incidents, from declaration through to post-incident review. You will work with Engineering, IT, Legal, Risk and senior stakeholders, and you will be credible with all of them.

AI is used widely across the business, in how we build software, run operations and serve customers, and that changes both what security incidents look like and how quickly we can respond to them. You will use AI and automation as a normal part of your work, and you will be able to investigate and respond to incidents where AI tooling is the cause, the target or the route in.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone with hands-on SOC experience and a track record of commanding incidents.

3. Operational Reporting & Assurance

  • Track and report SecOps metrics that reflect reality, such as alert quality, time to triage, time to contain, incident volumes and root causes.

  • Build working relationships with Engineering, Platform and IT Systems so that incident response is practised before it is needed.
