For more information, visit <a href="https://wppmedia.com/" target="_blank">wppmedia.com</a>.</p> <p>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It is through this synergy that we create truly exceptional experiences, both for our clients and for our internal teams. To succeed in this role, it is fundamental to embody the core values that unite WPP and WPP Media:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Extraordinary:</strong> Fostering collective leadership that inspires truly transformational creativity.</li> <li><strong>Create an Open Environment:</strong> Striking the perfect balance between employee fulfillment and client satisfaction, all built on mutual trust.</li> <li><strong>Lead with Optimism:</strong> Actively driving growth and development to energize our entire organization.</li> </ul> <h3>Missions &amp; Responsibilities</h3> <p>The Data Governance Director enforces global data standards, taxonomy integrity, and compliance across all luxury Maisons and markets, while ensuring data directly serves business and media performance objectives. Moving beyond purely operational data checks, this role bridges data control and strategic activation. The Director is responsible for transitioning data operations into an automated Prevention–Monitoring–Correction framework, challenging and simplifying existing processes, and leading/up-skilling the Data &amp; Tech team to ensure data is structured, trusted, and actionable for global reporting, Optimus dashboards, and WPP Open integrations.</p> <p>As the Data Governance Director, you will enforce global data standards, taxonomy integrity, and compliance across all luxury Maisons and markets. You will bridge data control and strategic activation by transitioning data operations from manual checks to an automated Prevention–Monitoring–Correction framework. You will lead and elevate the Data &amp; Tech team to guarantee clean, structured, and actionable data for global reporting, Optimus dashboards, and WPP Open integrations.</p> <h4>1. Data Governance &amp; Strategy</h4> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Alignment:</strong> Align data collection directly with business and media objectives, ensuring data is consistent, structured, and actionable across all activation and analytics teams.</li> <li><strong>Critical Thinking &amp; Process Simplification:</strong> Actively challenge existing processes, taxonomies, and naming conventions to eliminate complexity and propose simpler, more scalable, and effective approaches.</li> <li><strong>Framework &amp; Model Ownership:</strong> Build, own, and execute the end-to-end Prevention–Monitoring–Correction data model.</li> <li><strong>Annual Taxonomy Review:</strong> Lead the yearly cycle for global taxonomy review, cleanup, and integration of new data dimensions across all Maisons.</li> <li><strong>Naming Conventions:</strong> Enforce standardized naming conventions globally, including unique Campaign IDs to enable automated campaign record aggregation via Accutics or internal systems.</li> </ul> <h4>2. Team Leadership &amp; Structuring</h4> <ul> <li><strong>Team Elevation &amp; Upskilling:</strong> Lead, structure, and elevate the Data &amp; Tech team, developing their understanding of the broader digital, tech, and media ecosystem.</li> <li><strong>Workflow Framing:</strong> Frame and guide team workflows to break down operational silos, standardizing execution across Maisons and aligning daily tasks with strategic priorities and best practices.</li> <li><strong>Talent Guidance:</strong> Direct and advise Data Operations Executives and Associate Directors on best practices for automated data validation beyond basic string checking.</li> </ul> <h4>3. Operations &amp; Compliance Management</h4> <ul> <li><strong>Data Accuracy Enforcer:</strong> Drive global data compliance from current baselines up to a strict 95% accuracy target across all channels, Maisons, and markets.</li> <li><strong>Input Data Readiness:</strong> Ensure clean, trusted input data flows into Optimus dashboards (and ultimately WPP Open), eliminating fragmented taxonomies and reporting discrepancies.</li> </ul> <h3>Qualifications &amp; Profile</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 8–10+ years of proven experience in Digital Data Governance, Taxonomy Management, or Media Data Operations.</li> <li><strong>Background:</strong> Strong AdOps background with hands-on experience in digital tracking, ad serving, and multi-market data compliance.</li> <li><strong>Technical Knowledge:</strong> Deep understanding of taxonomy architecture, dynamic UTM/naming structures, Accutics, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), server-side tracking, and campaign management workflows.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Management:</strong> Proven track record of enforcing governance standards across multi-brand, multi-agency, and international team environments.</li> <li><strong>Key Soft Skills:</strong> Great autonomy, strong organizational skills, and a strategic mindset. High level of diplomacy, active listening, and the ability to communicate technical data governance standards clearly to both executive stakeholders and operational teams.</li> </ul> <h3>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</h3> <p>Our commitment to shaping the future of media is reflected in active support for the professional development of our talent, helping them reach their full potential. This approach goes hand-in-hand with a responsible vision in our media investment strategies, reflecting our dual priority: valuing our people while adopting sustainable practices across our industry.</p> <p>WPP Media employees have privileged access to WPP Media and WPP global networks, enabling them to expand their professional network and stay at the forefront of marketing and advertising innovation. We foster an inclusive work culture where team accomplishments and expertise are regularly celebrated through engaging internal events.</p> <p><strong>Our Benefits Include:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Hybrid Working Model:</strong> Up to 2 work-from-home days per week, plus 2 full weeks of remote work per year.</li> <li><strong>Additional Time Off:</strong> 2 extra days off offered annually, plus additional leave tiers based on seniority.</li> <li><strong>Inclusive Policies &amp; Well-being:</strong> Dedicated health leave programs (including up to 5 WFH days/month for employees suffering from endometriosis), specific support programs, and paid leave allowances for employees with recognized disability status (RQTH).</li> <li><strong>Social Impact:</strong> Opportunities to participate in community and solidarity missions via our "We care and we act" program.</li> </ul> <h3>Recruitment Process</h3> <ol> <li><strong>Recruiter Interview:</strong> An initial phone or video interview with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to discuss your experience, expectations, and answer your questions about the role and company.</li> <li><strong>Operational Interview:</strong> An in-depth interview with key operational leadership to evaluate your technical background, leadership style, and cultural fit.</li> <li><strong>Case Study / Technical Assessment:</strong> A case study presentation to demonstrate your practical skills in data governance architecture, taxonomy framework design, and stakeholder management.</li> </ol> <p>We are committed to making this process as fast, transparent, and collaborative as possible.</p> <p><em>WPP Media guarantees equal opportunity and considers all applicants without discrimination. Responsibilities

Manager & Employee Partnership

  • Work in close collaboration with R&D management to support them in the design of the organization

  • Act as the single HR contact for Switzerland: present daily in Crissier, and a reliable remote partner for Zurich with regular visits

  • Give managers concrete, operational HR answers grounded in Swiss law, and address employee concerns promptly

  • Communicate with the teams with pedagogy to support and explain the organization

Stay aligned with the Paris HR team and group policy while remaining locally compliant

Local Compliance & Employment Law

  • Own compliance with Swiss employment law across the employee lifecycle (contracts, probation, working time, leave, termination) and adapt group contracts and HR policies to Swiss requirements

  • Handle employee representation obligations as headcount grows and keep leadership ahead of regulatory change

  • Own the monthly payroll cycle with our provider and Finance: validate variable inputs (absences, overtime, bonuses, joiners, leavers) and cross-check payslips

  • Manage individual employee situations end to end: disciplinary procedures, conflict resolution, sensitive cases

  • Rigor, confidentiality, autonomy and a taste for building processes

  • Comfort with an HRIS (HiBob) and reporting tools

Languages

  • Fluent French and English; Swiss-German is an asset for Zurich

  • Experience in defense, aerospace or deeptech, and with multi-site teams

title: Business Operations & Data Specialist (Finance)
description: About the role Every number that reaches our leadership team, our board, and our auditors has to be right the first time — and that is where you come in. As a Business Operations & Data Specialist focused on Finance at Destinus, you are the bridge between the owners of our financial data, the CFO, and the wider finance team and the data in our lakehouse. You own how finance data is defined, where it comes from, how it is produced, and how it reaches the people who make decisions with it. This is as much an operations role as a reporting one. You will translate what finance needs to know into what the data platform has to deliver, working with our Data Engineers on the finance data in the lakehouse and building the dashboards the CFO and the finance team rely on. You will also improve the processes and systems that create the numbers in the first place, automate the manual work that eats the month, and make our finance data understandable to everyone who needs it, including our AI assistants. At Destinus, we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing — bringing speed, precision, and innovation to every process that powers our advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). We are a fast-growing international group operating across several European entities, and the standards we hold our financial data to are rising just as quickly. Join us in building a finance reporting foundation that is accurate, traceable, and ready for any question asked of it. What You'll Do Be the go-to contact between the business owners of finance data — the CFO, accounts payable and receivable, and treasury — and our lakehouse: turn their questions into clear data requirements, and the data back into answers they can act on. Build and maintain Power BI dashboards covering cash flow, receipts and collections, payables, and spend across the group, built on certified lakehouse data. Partner with our Data Engineers on the curated (gold) layer for finance: specify the tables, fields, and business rules — entities, currencies, financial dimensions, intercompany — and validate the result against the ledger before anyone relies on it. Prepare and quality-check entity-level data extractions from our lakehouse and ERP in support of the external audit, and keep audit requests tracked from request to delivery. Define and document finance KPI definitions in our KPI catalog — formulas, inclusions, exclusions, owners, and sources — to a standard that withstands external review. Describe our finance data in plain business language — what each field means, who owns it, and how sensitive it is — for our shared meanings layer, so that colleagues and our AI assistants can use it correctly without having to ask you first. Automate what is manual today: turn recurring spreadsheet work, audit packs, and month-end routines into repeatable processes that largely run themselves. Improve the finance processes and system configuration that create the data, working with the finance team and our ERP specialists, so that issues are fixed at source rather than corrected every month. Help the finance team get more from the tools through training and self-service, so they can answer their own questions. Requirements What You’ll Need Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Controlling, Economics, or a related field. A genuine finance background is essential — experience in external or internal audit, controlling, financial reporting, or FP&A. This is not a data role with finance on the side; you need to understand the accounting behind the figures. Confident with general ledger and subledger structures, trial balances, accounts payable and accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, intercompany transactions, and the principles of IFRS. Strong expertise in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, dashboard design, troubleshooting), complemented by advanced Excel skills. Comfortable querying data with SQL and working in a lakehouse or data warehouse environment; experience with Microsoft Fabric or a medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture is a plus. You will not build the pipelines — you need to know what to ask for and how to check what comes back. Able to explain data to finance colleagues and accounting logic to technical ones — and to get both sides to agree on one definition. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance is a strong advantage — the general ledger, accounts payable and accounts receivable modules, and the data structures underneath them. We run on D365, and someone who already knows it will be effective months earlier. An interest in improving how the system is configured and used matters as much as knowing where to click. A track record of simplifying or automating a process, not only reporting on it. Experience supporting an external audit, or working in a multi-entity, multi-currency international group, is a strong advantage. Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus. Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment is preferred. Who You Are You are precise, and you are curious about where a number came from before you are comfortable reporting it — whether that means reading the ledger or querying the lakehouse. You know the difference between a figure that looks right and a figure that can be traced back to its source, and you care about the second one. You are not content to rebuild the same report every month. When something is manual, repetitive, or fragile, your instinct is to go upstream and fix it rather than absorb it. You enjoy working with finance colleagues who ask hard questions, and you would rather be challenged on a detail than have it slip through. Above all, you want your work to be relied on, by the CFO, by the board, and by anyone who audits it.   Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Our client is an international bank based in Geneva. We are looking for an internal auditor or process risk specialist (m, f, d) as

Analyst Operational Risk

Your Tasks:

Ongoing review of operational risk scenarios based on the analysis of various IT data, including change management / Ensure compliance and further development of the internal control system / Responsible for the analysis and evaluation of key controls and risk mitigating measures in all processes / Analyzing operational incidents and processes / Reviewing systems for potential control weaknesses / Performing control testing / Performing regular testing of data quality of various data feeds / Further development of methodologies, procedures and reports / Supporting departments in conducting risk self-assessments and creating transparency in events, data interpretations and conclusions / Creating a culture of risk awareness for risk mitigation through targeted sustainability training / Ad hoc projects for senior management.

Your Profile:

Master's or Bachelor's degree in Information Systems or Business Administration / CIA, CISA as an advantage / Residence in Switzerland required / Banking experience gained in a Big Four company, in an internal audit or an operational risk department / Knowledge of private banking business and its processes / Knowledge of internal control systems and corporate governance / Experience with end-to-end risk audits / Experience with developing complex risk systems and change management as a project manager / Analytical and conceptual skills / High attention to details / Independent and team-orientated personality with a solution-oriented approach / Ability to work under time pressure / Strong communication skills / Proficiency in MS Office, Excel and/or Access/Power BI / Fluent in English and French, German as an advantage.

Your Contact:

Ivano Coni would like to support you. Your application will be kept strictly confidential.

raw.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

The opportunity

Our engineering teams build a product that enterprises run their purchase-to-pay and order-to-cash processes on every day. Much of the product knowledge behind it sits with our founders and domain experts. As we grow, we are moving from a project-oriented model, where features come top-down and success is measured by output, to a product-oriented one: empowered teams that own problems end-to-end and are measured by their impact on customers and the business.

As Head of Product, you lead that shift. You build the product management practice for the BLP Platform from an early stage. Our first product managers are joining stream-aligned teams, starting with Invoice and Procurement, and the team will grow to 4–5 PMs as we expand. You hire them, coach them, and set the standard for what great product work looks like at BLP.

You report to the CTO and work closely with Engineering, Projects, Sales, and our founders.

What you’ll do

  • Build and lead the product management practice for the BLP Platform: hire, coach, and develop a team of product managers as we scale.

  • Move the product organization from an output-driven model to an outcome-driven one.

  • Establish the product management craft at BLP: discovery practices, evidence-based decision making, and a clear standard for what “good” looks like in the role.

  • Transfer product knowledge out of the experts’ heads and into the teams, without losing the domain depth that got us here.

  • Build the direct line between our teams and our customers.

  • Make our data usable for product decisions. We have BigQuery, PostHog, and prediction-rate analytics available, and we want product managers who reach for them by default.

  • Shape how the product organization works as we grow: intake, prioritization, roadmapping, and the operating rhythm.

  • Contribute directly to product strategy for the platform.

What you bring

  • 10+ years in product management, including experience leading or formally coaching product managers, with a real point of view on how product people are developed.

  • Experience working in an empowered product model, where teams were assigned problems to solve rather than features to build.

  • A track record of shipping enterprise B2B software that customers actually adopted.

  • Experience moving an organization toward an empowered product model, including the political and cultural side of it.

  • The ability to hold a position with engineers, sales, and executives, and to say no in a way that keeps the relationship.

  • Entrepreneurial judgment: comfortable operating with incomplete information, choosing a direction, and owning the result.

  • Fluent English.

  • Enterprise ERP or finance exposure, experience with AI or agentic products in production (particularly reliability, evaluation, and trust in enterprise settings), and German are a plus.

Why BLP

  • Build a function: you shape how product management works at BLP while the team grows.

  • Direct work with the CTO and founders on product strategy for the platform.

  • A product with deep domain substance and a large enterprise customer base to learn from.

  • Employee participation plan.

How we work

  • Impact: We create measurable business outcomes.

  • Transparency: We build trust through openness.

  • Ownership: We take responsibility for outcomes.

  • Excellence: We relentlessly strive for greatness.

Practical information

  • Location: hybrid from our Zurich, London, Munich or Cologne offices, or remote elsewhere in Europe.

  • Employment: full-time, permanent.

raw.description:
About Prudentia Sciences

Prudentia Sciences is the scientific intelligence layer powering life sciences dealmaking. We bring together expert-developed scientific diligence frameworks, AI reasoning trained on drug development, and a unified evidence base to accelerate investment in breakthrough therapies. As a trusted third party operating between buyer and seller, we help build conviction through every stage of the deal, faster. We replace fragmented workflows with a single system that surfaces what matters earlier.

 

Backed by GV (Google Ventures), McKesson, Iaso Ventures, Virtue, and SignalFire - and built by people who have sat on every side of the table in life sciences dealmaking - we're on a mission to bring expert scientific judgment to every deal decision, at AI scale.

 

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Director of Customer Success to manage and scale a portfolio of strategic biopharma accounts. You'll own commercial outcomes for Top 25 biopharma customers, driving platform adoption, retention, and expansion to build a “business within the business”. Customer feedback from your portfolio will directly inform our product roadmap and operating model. You’ll operate with the judgment of an owner, not just execute a playbook.

What You'll Own

Commercial strategy

  • Own a portfolio of strategic biopharma accounts; drive the full commercial lifecycle - from implementation and onboarding through to retention and partnership expansion

  • Develop and execute account-level strategy, identifying expansion opportunities and leading renewal negotiations to achieve industry-leading retention rates

  • Monitor usage patterns, engagement signals, and business outcomes to proactively grow accounts and manage partnership signals

  • Transform satisfied customers into vocal advocates who provide references, case studies, testimonials, and speak at industry events

  • Serve as the voice of the customer to Product, Engineering, Sales, and Scientific teams, ensuring market feedback drives our product roadmap and strategic priorities

Lead Implementation and Drive Adoption

  • Orchestrate complex customer implementations including platform configuration, custom development, and data integrations aligned to customer use cases

  • Design and execute account-specific onboarding strategies, facilitating executive workshops, design sessions, and hands-on trainings that accelerate time-to-value

  • Proactively communicate product updates, new capabilities, and innovative use cases to maximize customer value realization

Provide Expert Technical Support

  • Diagnose and resolve platform issues through systematic troubleshooting, documenting problems clearly and coordinating with Engineering on appropriate resolution paths

  • Develop deep platform expertise that enables you to answer complex technical questions and guide customers through sophisticated workflows

  • Create feedback loops that ensure technical issues inform long-term product improvements

Who You Are

Essential Qualifications

  • 8+ years of customer success, management consulting, partnerships, account management, or implementation experience in pharmaceutical, biopharma, biotech, or life sciences industries

  • Working knowledge of drug development processes, portfolio management, and deal evaluation frameworks

  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder decision-making within large enterprise organizations

  • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to quickly master sophisticated software platforms and translate technical capabilities into business value

  • Exceptional executive communication skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with comfort operating in fast-paced, high-growth environments where priorities evolve quickly

 

Bonus points

  • Direct experience in biopharma Search & Evaluation, Business Development, Licensing, Portfolio Management, or Strategy roles

  • Track record of driving measurable customer outcomes, achieving retention and expansion targets

  • Hands-on experience with AI/ML platforms, advanced analytics tools, or decision intelligence software

  • Proficiency with customer success platforms (HubSpot, etc.)

  • Advanced degree (MS, PhD, MBA) in life sciences, business, or a related field

Location

We are strongly prioritizing candidates based in London (UK), Dublin (Ireland), or Basel (Switzerland) to support our EU-based clients. Today this role will be remote as we do not have a physical office in these locations, but as we scale, we intend to be hybrid 2x per week (Tues/Thurs).

 
 

Compensation: €89K – €110K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • Multiple Ranges

  • Dublin, Ireland • €89K – €110K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus
  • London, England • £85K – £110K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus
  • Basel, Switzerland • CHF 117K – CHF 150K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

title: Science Manager – Nature-based Solutions (80-100%)
description: As a Science Manager in Climeworks Solutions, you make sure that our nature-based solutions (NBS) portfolio meets the same demanding quality bar we apply to all our carbon dioxide removal offerings. Your focus is on Afforestation, Reforestation and Revegetation (ARR), Improved Forest Management (IFM) and Mangroves, but you are not limited to these. You will screen the market, identify and assess priority projects, and carry out due diligence on potential partners. You form and defend Climeworks Solutions' own, independent scientific view on the quality, risks and fit of NBS projects. You keep our assessment criteria up to date and apply them in practice. You work closely with the sourcing team to shape our approach to nature credits, from first supplier contact to partnerships and product positioning. This role gives you real influence on how we build our nature offering and how the wider removal market develops. Quality framework development: You adapt and sharpen Climeworks' quality assessment frameworks for nature-based pathways. You draw on the newest published methodologies and on standards as they evolve. Supplier assessment and monitoring: You build constructive relationships with relevant suppliers. You rate and benchmark their projects. Over time, you track how project quality and delivery change and flag any concerns early. Project due diligence: You run in-depth technical, scientific and commercial reviews of key projects. These cover additionality, measurability, carbon accounting, co-benefits, reversal risk and delivery risk. You combine many data sources, including GIS analysis, project documents and registry information, into clear recommendations. Pathway segmentation: As the CDR industry matures, you group projects into sub-pathways and archetypes. For each one, you develop a well-founded view of what quality means. Market intelligence and prioritization: Together with Sourcing, you map the project landscape across key regions and pathways. You identify the strongest projects and recommend them, based on methodological robustness, pricing, reputation and delivery record. Contracting support: You help Sourcing draft contracts with approved suppliers. You focus on negotiating quality-related terms and amendments. Partnership development: You help build relationships with important players in the ecosystem, such as rating agencies, registries, NGOs and other opinion leaders. Pathway strategy: You work with colleagues in Science, Sourcing and the wider Commercial team to define the strategy for each nature-based pathway. You consider market trends, quality benchmarks, demand and supply. Sales support: You advise on project selection and answer technical questions in customer discussions, pitches and tenders. Knowledge sharing: You keep colleagues informed about scientific progress, new methodologies and market developments in nature-based solutions. Education: You have a Master's degree in a relevant field, such as ecology, conservation science, environmental or natural sciences, forestry or geography. A PhD is an advantage. Experience: You have hands-on experience in nature-based carbon projects. This could be project development, project design documentation, independent project ratings, MRV, carbon modelling or biodiversity research. Experience in carbon markets and CDR, and with standards such as Verra, Gold Standard, Plan Vivo or Isometric, is a strong plus. Analytical skills: You work confidently with large and varied datasets, including GIS and statistical analysis. You are precise and scientifically rigorous, and you can reach sound conclusions even when data is incomplete. Critical thinking: You question assumptions, spot inconsistencies and find practical solutions by connecting findings across projects. Business judgement: You weigh commercial and strategic factors when assessing projects and shaping strategy. Communication and language: You explain complex topics in a clear and credible way, and you can show how robust your assessments are. You are fluent in written and spoken English. Way of working: You take ownership and manage several projects at once, with clean documentation. You are comfortable working across teams and in different environments. You balance independent judgement with close collaboration. Our promise: At Climeworks, you are accepted for who you are, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply – regardless of background, identity, or experience. Studies show that women and individuals from minority backgrounds often only apply for jobs when they meet 100% of the listed criteria. If this sounds like you, don’t hold back. If you think you’d make a great fit for this role, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t check every single box. Let’s tackle one of humankind’s greatest challenges together. What we offer: Time Off: Enjoy 25 paid vacation days every year, plus public holidays. Flexibility: Work how it suits you best. We offer a hybrid work setup and up to 4 weeks of remote work annually within any EU country. Ownership: Fair base pay paired with an equity package – because your contributions matter. Family Support: Inclusive parental leave. Continuous Learning: Dedicated budget to invest in your professional growth. Referral Rewards: Help us grow our team and earn bonuses for your successful referrals. Salary: At Climeworks, salary ranges are assigned to a job based on the level of seniority and the location specific market median of similar jobs according to external benchmark surveys. Individual compensation depends on your skills, experience, and the value you bring to the team. Formalities:   This position is based in Opfikon, Zurich, and we ask that you work onsite at least three days per week. The percentage in the job title means flexibility – choose full-time or part-time based on what works for you. We do not accept candidate profiles through recruitment agencies. raw.title: Reliability Engineer (NL)
raw.description:
Functie  Reliability engineer

 

Beschrijving functie

 

De reliability engineer is een productie specialist die de totale levensduur van installatie bestudeert en analyseert hoe het bedrijf omgaat met investeringen en onderhoud van assets.  De reliability engineer is de expert in het identificeren van potentiële risico’s en het voorkomen van stilstanden. Daar problemen moeilijk volledig te voorkomen zijn, geeft de reliability engineer adviezen hoe te handelen bij storingen die plaatsvinden. Het doel is te voorkomen dat fouten in productiesystemen optreden.

 

De reliability engineer analyseert tevens de veiligheidsrisico’s geassocieerd met installatie fouten. Ter voorkoming van stilstand maakt de reliability engineer onderhoudsschema’s en analyseert statistische gegevens die helpen te voorspellen wanneer en hoe fouten voor kunnen komen. De reliability engineer ontwikkelt inspectie criteria die gebruikt worden om de asset health te monitoren. 



Om dit te kunnen bereiken maakt de reliability engineer gebruik van een aantal technieken.

 

  • Voorlopige gevaren analyse: Preliminary hazard analysis is de initiële identificatie van potentiële gevaren en fouten in een productie proces of systeem

  • Failure modes and effect analysis ( FMEA): Betreft het opsommen van de manieren dat een proces of systeem kan falen en wat de consequenties hiervan zijn.

  • Criticality analysis: bepaalt hoe ernstig de consequenties zijn van een asset fout voor het productiesysteem van het bedrijf.

  • Onderhoudbaarheid: gedetailleerde informatie hoe efficiënt en betrouwbaar het bedrijf een onderdeel kan repareren.

  • Foutenboom analyse: onderzoek van een systeem fout door naar de kleinere voorafgaande gebeurtenissen te kijken die hebben bijgedragen aan de systeem fout



    • Taken

    1. Trouble shooting

      1. Faciliteren van root cause analyse in geval van complexe, multidisciplinaire afwijkingen/storingen waar de uitvoerende teams niet uitkomen

      2. Daily problem solving

    2. Continue verbeteren

      1. Periodieke analyse op performance killers en cost drivers om van daaruit middels verbetervoorstellen bij te dragen aan een maximale beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid van installaties tegen minimale kosten

      2. Innovatief denken m.b.t. het verlagen van de kosten en verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid

      3. Leiden/faciliteren van verbeterteams c.q. verbeterprojecten

    3. Change Management

      1. Beoordelen van wijzigingen op technische haalbaarheid met het bestaande machinepark. Vanuit procurement komen verzoeken op het gebied van grondstof wijzigingen ( andere leverancier, andere specificaties ed.) 

      2. Begeleiden van proeven vanuit de technische kant op de machines

      3. Installatie nieuwe machines / introductie nieuwe producten 

    4. Technische beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid

      1. Evalueren van preventief onderhoud en voorstellen doen ter verbetering met als doel het verhogen van de beschikbaarheid van het machinepark

      2. Het verlagen van onderhoudskosten door het optimaliseren van onderhoudsconcepten en doorvoeren van technische verbeteringen.

    5. Investeringsprojecten

      1. Participeren in investeringsprojecten om de onderhoudbaarheid te borgen en het inregelen van onderhoud en spare parts.

      2. Inbrengen van technische kennis en ervaringen.

      3. Toezien op naleving van de standaard op gebied van onderdelen en installaties.

    6. Onderhoudsstrategie bepalen

      1. Opstellen van effectieve onderhoudsconcepten zodat onderhoud van de installaties op de meest efficiënte en effectieve manier kan worden gerealiseerd tegen zo laag mogelijke kosten

      2. Borgen van compliance; het inregelen van wettelijke inspecties en keuringen  en toezien op tijdige uitvoering daarvan.

    7. Beheren van de Standard Operating Procedures voor de installaties (SOP)

      1. Schrijven van nieuwe SOP’s, inclusief autonoom onderhoud

      2. Herzien van SOP’s als gevolg van proces verbeteringen en aanpassingen

    8. Bewaken standaarden voor veiligheid en kwaliteit

      1. Uitvoeren van risico assessments

      2. Borgen dat processen voldoen aan veiligheids standaarden en kwaliteits standaarden.

      3. Uitvoeren van optimalisatie testen.

      4. Ontwikkelen van best practice  die de productkwaliteit borgen

title: Security Architect
description: Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products.     Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters   At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas:  Physical/embedded device security.  OT (operational technology) network security.  OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications.  Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines.   What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun.  As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact.  What you will be doing   As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments.  As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors.  Security standards, policies, and design patterns library  Security architecture review process  Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation  Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register  Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services.  Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies)  Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape  Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites.  Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work.   To succeed in this role:   You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will".  You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. raw.title: Security Architect
raw.description:
Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products.  

  

Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters 

At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: 

  1. Physical/embedded device security. 

  1. OT (operational technology) network security. 

  1. OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. 

  1. Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines.  

What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. 

As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. 

What you will be doing 

As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments. 

 As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. 

  • Security standards, policies, and design patterns library 

  • Security architecture review process 

  • Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation 

  • Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register 

  • Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services. 

  • Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies) 

  • Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape 

  • Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites. 

Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work.  

To succeed in this role: 

  • You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will". 

  • You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. You know and can show by example how to "test securely as well as test security" 

  • You are a great collaborator who can be a valuable sparring partner with product managers to understand and refine customer's needs for security so that you define the right security designs for market segments. Engineering managers rely on your ability to steer security implementations within the product teams. 

  • You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure. 

  • You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run. 

  • You can translate security designs into engineering specifications, appraise implementation designs, conduct code reviews. This role with a strong hands-on component, not just a pure governance role. 

  • You understand and can register, document, and communicate clearly risks and trade-offs between differen t project execution scenarios 

  • You have had hands-on experience implementing security designs using modern programming language and frameworks, and you are able to coach product teams to increase their secure coding maturity e.g. by running threat modelling workshops with the engineering team. 

  • You have vast experience with architecture roles with 3-5 years of experience specifically focusing on security. 

In addition, you have the following technical expertise: 

  • Proven track record across at least two of the three domains: OT/IoT/embedded security, network security, cloud security 

  • You are familiar with modern authentication and authorization frameworks (JWT, OpenID, SAML) and (REST) API security and protection approached 

  • ISO 27001 and IEC 62443-4 understanding at a working level 

  • Working knowledge with or excellent ability to apply the PKI and certificate lifecycle management at scale; also, with the vision how to implement this in OT/IoT deployment contexts 

  • Solid network security understanding: firewall policy, micro-segmentation, DMZ design for IT/OT boundaries 

  • Zero trust architecture principles 

  • Secure SDLC and DevSecOps tools and practices (think about OWASP, SANS25, Snyk, Black Duck, etc) 

  


The following competence is desired: 

  • OT/ICS protocols and architectures (such as BACnet Secure Connect, Modbus, DNP3, MQTT, AMQP) 

  • Embedded device security for industrial PCs, systems-on-chip, and microcontrollers: secure boot, hardware security modules (HSMs), TPM, secure enclave concepts, firmware & data signing, encryption 

  • Cloud security on at least one major platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) 

  • Container and Kubernetes security 

  • Secrets management and key management systems (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) 

  • Priva's technical stack is C#/C++/.NET and Angular. Experience implementing production projects with this stack is preferred, but not required if you are able to learn it quickly (based on your vast experience) 

What we offer you 

  

💶 Excellent remuneration — competitive and aligned with experience. 

🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 more at half price. 

🏦 Excellent pension contribution. 

🎓 Education budget of €1,000 per year. 

⏰ Flexible working hours. 

🍱 Onsite canteen (e.g., poke bowl for €2). 

🏋️ Free onsite gym. 

🎉 Vibrant, open culture.

title: Sr. Engineering Manager - Developer Ecosystem
description: <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">RDQ427R369</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business.</span></p> <p>Our Developer Ecosystem organisation shapes how developers and the AI agents working for them build on the Databricks Data and AI Platform, from within the product to the tools they already use.</p> <p>We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our declarative deployment framework, which turns data and AI projects into versioned, reviewable, repeatable software. It is one product with two entry points. Third-party developers use our open-source CLI from their IDEs, terminals, and CI/CD systems. First-party, they author, deploy and inspect the same projects inside the Databricks workspace. In both, AI agents increasingly do the work: coding agents drive the CLI, and our in-product AI assistant authors and deploys projects alongside the developer. Thousands of organisations run their CI/CD on it, and it is one of the fastest-growing parts of the platform.</p> <p>The team owns the deployment engine and CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and the metadata service and deployment history that record every deployment. The hard problems are real infrastructure-as-code problems: reconciling declared and live state, making plans safe for humans and agents to approve, keeping visual authoring and code in sync, and shipping weekly releases that remain backwards-compatible for our largest customers.</p> <p><strong>The impact you will have:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and grow the team:</strong> Manage a team of senior engineers across three closely connected areas (the deployment engine and open-source CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and deployment history and metadata), working with strong tech leads. Hire, coach and promote, and grow engineers into tech leads.</li> <li><strong>Make agentic development the default path:</strong> Shape how developers and AI agents author, validate and deploy projects, both inside the workspace and from the developer's own coding agent. Design the tools, skills and guardrails so agents get the same safety and auditability as humans.</li> <li><strong>Own the strategy and roadmap:</strong> Partner with Product and Design to set a multi-quarter roadmap for declarative deployment: agentic development, governed deployments and deployment history, enterprise CI/CD, and new resource coverage. Make the trade-offs explicit when the demand is larger than the team.</li> <li><strong>Raise the bar on execution and operational excellence:</strong> Run a predictable delivery process for a fast-moving, open-source product with frequent releases. Own reliability, on-call health, incident response and the quality bar for a tool customers depend on to ship to production.</li> <li><strong>Treat backward compatibility as a product feature:</strong> Lead engine and configuration migrations without forcing customers through a flag day, and communicate change clearly to customers, the community and field teams.</li> <li><strong>Lead across the platform:</strong> Drive alignment with the many platform teams whose resources and services the framework deploys, and with our sibling teams in Developer Ecosystem (SDKs, CLI, IaC provider, IDE). Make the whole toolchain feel like one product.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we look for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years managing software engineering teams, and 8+ years of software engineering experience overall.</li> <li>A track record of building and shipping developer tools or platforms used by many external developers or internal teams, such as infrastructure-as-code, deployment or CI/CD systems, CLIs, SDKs, or internal developer platforms.</li> <li>A deep understanding of declarative systems and deployment workflows: plan/apply, state management, drift and reconciliation, environment promotion, GitOps.</li> <li>Enough technical depth to engage on architecture and trade-offs with senior and staff engineers, and to hold a high-quality bar for public, versioned interfaces.</li> <li>Experience leading teams through ambiguity, with competing priorities from customers, partners and platform dependencies, and making clear calls.</li> <li>Strong product sense and a customer-first mindset. You enjoy talking to developers, reading their issues, and turning feedback into roadmap.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication, including with executives, partner teams and an external developer community.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Stand-out experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Built or led teams on infrastructure-as-code or deployment platforms, e.g. Terraform, Pulumi, AWS CDK / CloudFormation, Kubernetes controllers, Argo CD / Flux / Helm, or Vercel / Netlify-style deploy platforms.</li> <li>Managed an open-source developer tool with an active community and a frequent release cadence.</li> <li>Shipped developer workflows for AI coding agents (CLI-first tooling, agent skills, MCP), or AI-assisted authoring.</li> <li>Have managed managers or multiple teams (~15 to 20+ engineers), owned a multi-year platform strategy, and grown tech leads and managers.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&amp;T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/databricks">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://x.com/databricks">X</a>, <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@Databricks">YouTube</a>, and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/databricksinc/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.<br><br><strong>Benefits<br><br></strong></span>At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/154un3e8Xav4BceOSlcYFZRGEuQI54xMxVydRwQn54eQ/edit?usp=sharing">here</a>.<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</strong></p> <p>At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.</p> <p><strong>Compliance</strong></p> <p><strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.</span></strong></p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases.</p> <p>Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is open to candidates residing in Netherlands</p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world:</strong> Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.</li> <li><strong>You thrive the most when solving problems:</strong> Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.</li> <li><strong>You are a natural relationship builder:</strong> Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.</li> <li><strong>You are the architect of your own career:</strong> If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.</li> <li><strong>You want to be with the best: </strong>At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.</li> </ul> <p><strong>In this role, you will:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Monitor security events and provide technical analysis on alerts</li> <li>Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident</li> <li>Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives</li> <li>Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat</li> <li>Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices</li> <li>Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum requirements for the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response</li> <li>Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal</li> <li>Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara’s investigation processes, with proficiency in Python</li> <li>Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis</li> <li>Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams</li> <li>Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux</li> <li>Experience utilizing SIEM tools to perform log reviews</li> <li>Experience in cloud architecture and security (AWS, GCP) and cloud-based services</li> <li>Participation in an on-call rotation, with the potential to work outside standard business hours, including late evenings, when responding to high-severity incidents as part of our global incident response team.</li> <li>This role will be part of our EMEA so your hours will be aligned to the UK. As an operational time you may be expected to work flexible hours around this to support the load of the team</li> </ul> <p><strong>An ideal candidate also has:</strong></p> <ul> <li>2+ years of experience working on insider threat initiatives or employee investigations</li> <li>Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field - or relevant industry experience</li> <li>GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) or similar Certification</li> <li>Familiarity with common security frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, FedRAMP</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why <a href="https://www.samsara.com/company/careers/benefits">our rewards</a> are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.</p> <p>Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.</p> <p><strong>Flexible Working&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.</span></p> <p><strong>Belonging at Samsara</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.</p> <p><strong>Accommodations&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. And we have something important in common (other than our very well-worn passports): We want to change the way people travel. And that's exactly what we're doing, with the travel app to plan, track, and relive trips in a smart and beautiful way. Product & growth teams run experiments and analyse the data every week, leadership need clear reports for investors, and all of that depends on data that is reliable, modelled and compliant. You'll set the direction for our data platform, bring structure to data governance, and own the data infra that helps our product managers, marketers and data scientists do their job even better. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijnvisie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Meer weten? Neem contact op met onze Campus recruiter! title: Security Engineer
description: Security Engineer - Maatwerk Software met Impact Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij. Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details. Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Security Engineer . Iemand die veel energie krijgt van het opbouwen van een nieuw technisch securitydomein. Een gedreven specialist die graag zelf de regie neemt over de inrichting van moderne tooling en veilige architectuur. Jouw rol Als Security Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor de technische beveiliging van onze infrastructuur, interne werkplekken en cloudomgevingen. Je bouwt het securitydomein verder uit en selecteert de juiste tooling voor Dawn. Je beheert de gekozen systemen en richt deze tot in de puntjes in. Daarbij vertaal je complexe techniek naar een gedegen en onderbouwd advies voor verschillende afdelingen. Je vormt hiermee de verbindende brug tussen tech leads, hostingteams en Interne IT. Beleid en compliance pakt het ISO-team op, zo kun jij je volledig op de techniek focussen. Wat je zal gaan doen: Je werkt mee aan en verbetert centrale security-tooling zoals EDR en SIEM. Je werkt hands-on aan kwetsbaarhedenbeheer, actieve detectie, monitoring en het ontwerpen van hardening-standaarden. Je adviseert tech leads en hostingteams over veilige architectuur en helpt hen bij security-initiatieven. Je fungeert als het vaste technische aanspreekpunt voor het SOC en beoordeelt samen escalaties. Je draait mee in de technische analyse bij incidenten en bewaart de rust binnen het crisisteam. Wie ben jij? Je hebt een hbo-denkniveau en bij voorkeur een achtergrond in Cyber Security of Informatica . Je brengt een stevige basis mee in security engineering of infrastructuurbeveiliging. Je bezit hands-on ervaring met moderne security controls, IAM, secure configuration en kwetsbaarhedenmanagement. Kennis van cloudomgevingen zoals AWS en affiniteit met netwerkarchitectuur is een grote pré. Je bent zeer leergierig naar nieuwe technieken en toetst gemaakte keuzes altijd scherp en kritisch. Je zoekt actief de verbinding met collega's om samen de beveiliging naar een hoger niveau te brengen. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels en bent bereid om (hybride) te werken op onze kantoren in Geldermalsen en Hilversum. Wat bieden wij jou? De Organisatie : Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software. Autonomie : Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie. Maatschappelijke Impact : Je beveiligt cruciale systemen voor Dawn Technology en haar klanten. Salaris : Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4.500,- en €6.000,- passend bij jouw ervaring. Vakantiedagen : 25 vakantiedagen om volop te ontspannen. Werkplek & Sfeer : Gezellige werksfeer, flexibele werktijden, hybride werken en verzorgde lunch op kantoor (verschillende locaties maar je bent voornamelijk te vinden in Geldermalsen en Hilversum). Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken : Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding en een fiscaal fietsplan. Pensioen : Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen. Ontwikkeling & Extra's : Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen. Events & Fun : Toffe (lokale) teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events. Over Dawn Technology We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen, van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend. Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. title: Product Owner Werkplek & Support (Detachering / ZZP)
description: Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren.  Wie ben jij Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen.   Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten.   Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn.   Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers.   Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers. Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat. Wat ga je doen Wat breng je mee? Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen. •    Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bepalen van visie, roadmap en prioriteiten voor een IT-product of IT- dienst;    Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen; •    Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn; •    Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee; •    Je hebt ervaring met externe IT-dienstverleners en weet in operationele samenwerking, samen met het team, verbeteringen te realiseren; •    Je begrijpt werkplekdienstverlening en IT om inhoudelijk een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn; •    Je hebt ervaring met het verbeteren van dienstverlening en kunt sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid en klantbeleving; •    Je kunt omgaan met weerstand, bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie stellen en koers houden wanneer nog niet alles duidelijk is; •    Je beschikt over hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau. Ervaring met Microsoft 365 is welkom, maar diepgaande technische expertise is niet noodzakelijk. Ervaring met grotere transities of het insourcen van IT-dienstverlening is een pré. Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support ben je verantwoordelijk voor de visie, roadmap en prioritering van onze werkplek- en supportdienstverlening. Daarbij staat één vraag centraal: hoe zorgen we dat onze collega's prettig, veilig en efficiënt kunnen werken én snel en goed geholpen worden wanneer ondersteuning nodig is? We willen vooral sneller en voorspelbaarder worden in wat we leveren en tegelijkertijd de gebruikerstevredenheid verder verhogen. Jij vertaalt die ambitie naar concrete keuzes en verbeteringen.   •    ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de visie, roadmap en backlog voor Werkplek & Support; •    prioriteren van ontwikkelingen, incidenten en structurele verbeteringen; •    vertalen van IT-doelstellingen en behoeften van medewerkers naar concrete prioriteiten; •    richting geven aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft 365-gerichte werkplek, randapparatuur en ondersteunende dienstverlening; •    sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid, kwaliteit en gebruikerstevredenheid; •    onderhouden van nauw contact met stakeholders, waaronder Regionale Univé's en decentrale beheerders, en hen meenemen in keuzes en veranderingen; •    afstemmen met engineers, architecten, security, servicemanagement, leveranciers en andere IT-teams; •    samen met het team operationeel aansturen van de externe servicedesk en andere relevante leveranciers en verbeteringen realiseren; •    signalen en terugkerende vragen vanuit Support gebruiken om de werkplek structureel te verbeteren; •    richting geven aan lifecyclemanagement, upgrades, migraties en vernieuwingen van de werkplek en randapparatuur; •    kansen rond onder andere automatisering, selfservice en AI vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen; •    organiseren en voorbereiden van Scrum-activiteiten binnen het team, waaronder sprintplanning, reviews en retrospectives.   Je krijgt daarbij ruimte om zelfstandig richting te geven. Dat betekent ook dat we verwachten dat je bestaande keuzes kritisch bevraagt en de teammanager durft te challengen wanneer jij denkt dat het beter kan. Wat bieden wij Je krijgt een functie binnen IT Kern Services voor 36–40 uur per week met veel ruimte om zelf richting te geven. Werkplek & Support wordt dagelijks door duizenden collega's gebruikt. De keuzes die jij maakt zijn dus direct merkbaar in de organisatie. Ontwikkeling vinden we bij Univé belangrijk. Dat geldt voor de dienstverlening waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent, maar ook voor jezelf. Het team werkt hybride vanuit Zwolle en Assen. Er is één vaste teamdag per week, afwisselend in Zwolle en Assen. De overige dagen werk je veelal vanuit je standplaats of thuis. Wie wij zijn Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie. Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé.  IT Kern levert het IT-fundament waarmee Univé haar doelen kan realiseren. Binnen IT Kern richt Services zich onder andere op werkplekdiensten, eerstelijns gebruikersondersteuning, proces- en servicemanagement en consultancy. Binnen Werkplek & Support werk je samen met functioneel beheerders, IT-specialisten en een Business Informatie Analist. De servicedesk en het lokale beheer in Zwolle en Assen worden momenteel geleverd door een externe partner. Je komt terecht in een team met verschillende achtergronden en ervaringsniveaus, binnen een organisatie met veel verschillende belangen en afhankelijkheden. Dat maakt de omgeving soms complex, maar geeft je als Product Owner ook veel ruimte om verbinding te leggen en zichtbaar verschil te maken.
